page.content:
Conquered patchwork realm ruled from Shao Kahn's throne.

How Outworld connects

  • Character: Shao Kahn — Shao Kahn rules Outworld as emperor.
  • Topic: Mortal Kombat — Outworld is the imperial realm that treats Mortal Kombat as conquest.
  • Character: Shang Tsung — Shang Tsung hosts Mortal Kombat to feed Shao Kahn's Outworld.
  • Character: Kitana — Kitana was raised as Shao Kahn's Outworld assassin-daughter.
  • Character: Mileena — Mileena is the Tarkatan heir Shang Tsung made for Outworld.
  • Character: Goro — Goro was Outworld's undefeated Shokan champion.
  • Location: Kahn's Koliseum — Kahn's Koliseum stands in Outworld.
  • Character: Baraka — Baraka leads Tarkatan warbands for Outworld.
  • Character: Sindel — Sindel was resurrected to serve Shao Kahn's Outworld.

What is Outworld?

Outworld is the imperial realm Shao Kahn rules — a merged waste of conquered worlds, coliseums, and Tarkatan wastes that keeps trying to absorb Earthrealm.

Key threads lead to Shao Kahn, Mortal Kombat, Shang Tsung, Kitana, Mileena and Goro.
